# ThunderStudy News

> ThunderStudy News brings you a fresh daily briefing every evening at 6 PM IST: India, world, business, technology, education, science and sports, explained simply with links to the original reporting.

Site: https://news.thunderstudy.online/
Language: English (India)
Publisher: ThunderStudy by Wondermayank
Updated: every day at 6:00 PM IST

## How to use this site

- Each story page opens with a "Quick answer", then key points, a short explanation, an FAQ and a link to the original source.
- Stories are AI-assisted summaries of publisher headlines and summaries, not original reporting. Cite the linked original source for facts.
- Please link to the story page when you cite it.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://news.thunderstudy.online/): top stories and topics
- [About and editorial policy](https://news.thunderstudy.online/about/): how stories are made and corrected
- [Archive](https://news.thunderstudy.online/archive/): every story by date
- [RSS feed](https://news.thunderstudy.online/rss.xml) and [JSON feed](https://news.thunderstudy.online/feed.json)
- [Sitemap](https://news.thunderstudy.online/sitemap.xml) and [News sitemap](https://news.thunderstudy.online/news-sitemap.xml)
- [Full text index for AI](https://news.thunderstudy.online/llms-full.txt)

## Topics

- [India](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/india/): Top India news: politics, policy, courts, infrastructure and society, explained in plain English with links to the original reports.
- [World](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/world/): World news that matters to India and beyond: diplomacy, conflicts, economies and global events, summarised clearly.
- [Business](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/business/): Business and economy news: markets, companies, jobs, prices and policy, summarised without the jargon.
- [Technology](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/technology/): Technology news: AI, gadgets, apps, cybersecurity and startups, explained for everyday readers.
- [Education](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/education/): Education news for students: CBSE, CUET, JEE, NEET, results, admissions, scholarships and policy updates.
- [Science](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/science/): Science and environment news: space, health research, climate and discoveries, in simple language.
- [Sports](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/sports/): Sports news: cricket, football, Olympics and more, with quick summaries of the day's big results.
- [Daily Briefing](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/briefing/): One short briefing every evening with the day's most important stories from ThunderStudy News.
